cases.title: 21 overlapping wavelength spectra
cases.task: Follow one spectrum through the crossings near 300-350 nm and match it to the R legend.

cases.title: Temperature and titration spectra
cases.task: Track the ordering of the curves before and after the shared crossing. Keep temperature and titrant interpretations separate.

cases.title: Four titration curves
cases.task: Trace the red and green curves through both rises. Check that the written curve labels still identify the same paths.

cases.title: Absorption bands and colored solutions
cases.locator: PDF pp.1 and 3 | Solutions colorées / Le sirop de menthe
cases.task: Use the spectra and wavelength scale to distinguish absorbed bands. Preserve the physical meaning of spectrum colors.

cases.title: Four spectra at different pH
cases.task: Follow the magenta, orange, cyan and green curves through their common crossing.

cases.title: Dilution changes the curve
cases.locator: Web figures | Two superimposed solution curves
cases.task: Compare the two curves on each graph. Separate the measurement traces from the dense green grid.

cases.title: Gene profiles and 19 trajectories
cases.task: Distinguish the six gene profiles and their error bars. In the smaller panel, distinguish the two groups among 19 trajectories.
cases.note: Figure 1: hb red; gt magenta; Kr green; kni cyan; otd blue; tll black.

cases.title: Drosophila in a French lesson
cases.locator: Web figure | Expression de gènes gap
cases.task: Match each gene name in the legend to its expression profile, particularly blue/magenta and red/green curves.

cases.title: Ten crossing genetic trajectories
cases.task: Choose a colored trajectory near the beginning and follow it to the end without switching at a crossing.

cases.title: Genetic drift in two populations
cases.task: Compare the spread of the ten trajectories in the two graphs, then follow one trajectory within each graph.

cases.title: Photosynthesis and pigments
cases.task: Identify the chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b and carotenoid curves from their labels and follow them across the wavelength axis.

cases.title: Insulin response curves
cases.task: Match each response curve to its direct label, then compare its peak and later trend.

cases.title: Sea-level scenarios in an SVT lesson
cases.task: Identify the colored scenario bands and compare the end-of-century projections without losing the uncertainty ranges.

cases.title: Red and green fluorescence
cases.task: Use the DNA, membrane and CFTR channel labels to compare individual and combined images.

cases.title: Two-color microarray diagram
cases.locator: PDF p.14 | Measuring relative target abundance
cases.task: Follow treatment and control samples through labeling, mixing and detection. Check that red and green keep their intended roles.

cases.title: Dense red-black-green expression map
cases.task: Inspect two neighboring gene rows and distinguish high, low and dark cells while keeping the sample columns aligned.

cases.title: A heatmap from a statistics course
cases.task: Read one row across C, H, T and HT. Relate the red/green values to the color key rather than the dendrogram geometry.

cases.title: Volcano plot and expression heatmap
cases.task: Separate red and green point groups in the volcano plot, then interpret the independent color scale in the heatmap.

cases.title: Published color-vision comparison
cases.task: Compare each palette with its existing protanopia column. This figure is a reference comparison already present in the source.

cases.title: Regression coefficient paths
cases.task: Match the coefficient paths to their legend and follow their shrinkage. Notice the existing dashed styles as backup cues.

cases.title: 47 algorithm series
cases.task: Select a legend entry and follow its curve. Colors repeat, so retain the solid/dashed distinction and algorithm identifiers.

cases.title: 32 algorithm series
cases.task: Track a curve through the densest overlap and match its line style to the corresponding legend entry.

cases.title: 30 algorithm series
cases.task: Compare neighboring curves with similar colors while preserving the meaning of each line style.

cases.title: Twelve fingerprint-matching curves
cases.task: Identify one curve from the legend and compare its performance at the same false-acceptance value as another curve.

cases.title: 29 countries, six indicators
cases.task: Locate a country, read its numeric cells and compare the color encoding across indicators. Keep every value unchanged.

cases.title: Financial stability across a decade
cases.locator: PDF p.46 | Printed p.39, Figure A.1
cases.task: Track one indicator across years and distinguish low, middle and high values using the red-yellow-green scale.

cases.title: Mediterranean temperature curves
cases.task: Follow the highlighted yearly curves among the historical traces and distinguish the two ends of the map's temperature scale.

cases.title: The soil-moisture map from the chat
cases.task: Distinguish negative and positive extremes, then trace the darkest colors back to the numerical legend.

cases.title: Twelve monthly soil-moisture maps
cases.task: Compare the same region across months and keep negative and positive anomalies distinct.

cases.title: Soil-moisture extremes and time series
cases.task: Link each numbered area on the map to its monthly series and distinguish wet from dry conditions.

cases.title: Fine colored river networks
cases.task: Compare low-flow and high-flow categories along thin rivers. Preserve the seven-category ordering in the legend.

cases.title: A climate-model ensemble
cases.task: Distinguish individual model traces, ensemble summaries and observations, including inside the inset.

cases.title: Overlapping emissions-scenario simulations
cases.locator: PDF p.91 | FAQ 4.2, Figure 1, lower panel
cases.task: Separate the thin red and blue simulated temperature paths from the thicker averages.

cases.title: Precipitation change and hatching
cases.task: Distinguish positive and negative precipitation change independently of the overlaid hatching categories.

cases.title: Precipitation at four warming levels
cases.task: Compare one region at 1.5, 2, 3 and 4 degrees of warming while retaining both the color scale and the uncertainty hatching.

cases.title: Transport trends and complaint categories
cases.locator: PDF pp.3 and 5 | Reliability / Comments and complaints
cases.task: Follow the red and green service curves, then match the pie slices to their direct labels.

cases.title: Transport curves with point markers
cases.task: Compare red and green service curves and use the existing point markers and target line as additional cues.

cases.title: Student and classmate learning profiles
cases.task: Separate the red student trace and green comparison trace from the many blue classmate traces in the radar diagrams.

cases.title: Red-amber-green dashboard pies
cases.task: Read each status proportion and compare dashboards. Retain the printed percentages and category labels.

cases.title: Dense hospital performance cells
cases.task: Follow one ward across columns and compare cell fills and tiny bars without shifting numbers or headings.

cases.title: Original demo - crossing red/green lines
cases.task: Identify which product is higher each month. The source page is appended without changing its content stream.

cases.title: Synthetic control - 32 crossing spectra
cases.task: Use the reading checks printed on the source page; the original synthetic PDF contains the answer key.

cases.title: Synthetic control - 48 grouped bars
cases.task: Use the reading checks printed on the source page; verify labels and values after adaptation.
